evals.prompt: my swarm.join takes like 20 seconds to connect to anything when i restart the app, every single time. is this normal?
evals.expected_output: Likely missed swarm.destroy() on previous exit -> stale DHT records. Also check UDP firewall. Always Pear.teardown(() => swarm.destroy()).

evals.prompt: i need two peers to find each other knowing each other's public key (not a shared topic). hyperswarm or hyperdht?
evals.expected_output: HyperDHT — dht.createServer + server.listen(keyPair), client side dht.connect(publicKey).

evals.prompt: i have two parts of my app — chat and inbox. should i make two Hyperswarm instances for them?
evals.expected_output: No. One Hyperswarm per app. Join both topics on the same swarm; use store.namespace to scope the Corestore if needed.

assertions.value: Tells the user not to create two Hyperswarm instances and explains that one swarm can join many topics.

evals.prompt: i'm getting random `uncaughtException` crashes from peer streams. error happens on conn.write after the other side disconnects
evals.expected_output: Always attach conn.on('error', () => {}). SecretStreams emit on close.

assertions.value: Explicitly recommends attaching an error handler to every connection.

evals.prompt: what's the right way to broadcast a message to every peer in my swarm?
evals.expected_output: `for (const conn of swarm.connections) conn.write(message)` — or use protomux for typed framing.
